conditionMatchedLog.filter: log_id("docker") AND jsonPayload.scope="report" AND jsonPayload.msg="report accepted"

documentation.content: Report ${log.extracted_label.reportId}, reason ${log.extracted_label.reason}. Read it on the VM with `whim-admin reports show ${log.extracted_label.reportId}` (docs/deploy.md, Operating: Alerts). At most one email per 5 minutes: `whim-admin reports list` shows any others.
